subject: Clarion Bio - anchoring SKUs & incremental onramp (commit term tradeoffs)
messages:
From: Alicia Gomez <agomez@clarionbio.com>
To: Priyom Das <priyom@redwood.ai>
Date: Sun, 14 Mar 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Anchoring SKUs and phased onramp - request

Hi Priyom,

Thanks again for the demo last week. Procurement asked me to send our expected demand profile and a short note on what flexibility we need in the contract. Attached is Clarion_Demand_Schedule_v2.xlsx — it shows expected usage by month for year one and a conservative view for year two.

Key asks:
- We want a 24-month reserved commit but need the first 3 months to be a soft start at ~40% of the eventual committed pool while we validate latency and throughput in production.
- If we hit a deployment delay, Clarion will need a credit or delayed billing window rather than paying for idle capacity.
- We are open to longer terms (36 months) if there is a clear price step and a faster ramp start.

Can Redwood propose an anchoring approach where we lock an "anchor" SKU and then scale in predictable tranches? Also please call out how throughput guarantees (tokens/sec or p95 latency) are measured and any credits tied to failure to meet them.

Cc'ing Procurement (procure@clarionbio.com). Looking for a short options memo we can circulate internally.

Best,
Alicia Gomez
Head of AI Platforms
Clarion Bio
From: Priyom Das <priyom@redwood.ai>
To: Alicia Gomez <agomez@clarionbio.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.ai>
Date: Sun, 14 Mar 2027 09:31:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Anchoring SKUs and phased onramp - request

Hi Alicia — thanks for the demand sheet; that's helpful. I've looped in Monica (Customer Success) and Marissa (Solutions) so we can align on the technical and billing side.

High level options (we'll follow up with a short PDF):
1) 24-month (baseline)
   - Anchor SKU: a fixed reserved pool (example: 48 vGPU-equivalent units).
   - Soft-start: first 3 months billed at 40% of anchor capacity; utilization above soft-start is billed at standard overage rates.
   - Ramp: months 4-9 linear ramp to 100% of anchor (10% increments/month).
   - Discount: 18% off hosted list for 24-mo anchor.
2) 36-month (best price)
   - Anchor SKU same, soft-start reduced to 30% for first 2 months, faster ramp to 100% by month 6.
   - Discount: 25% off hosted list.
3) 12-month (short commit)
   - Smaller anchor SKU, higher month-to-month top-up pricing; minimal discount.

Throughput & SLA notes:
- We measure throughput guarantees as a combination of steady-state tokens/sec per GPU-equivalent and p95 generation latency at your median sequence length.
- Credits: if Redwood misses committed throughput for a rolling 7-day window (after onboarding stabilization), we offer service credits pro-rated to the anchor fee for affected days.

On credits for delayed start: we can offer a one-time invoice deferral for the soft-start period up to 60 days; beyond that we prefer converting unpaid months into a shorter-term consumption tranche at a reduced credit rate.

Next steps: Monica will send an attachments-based options PDF with concrete numbers; Marissa can run a sizing sanity check against your sheet. Can we schedule a 30-minute call on Wednesday to walk procurement through the proposals?

— Priyom
Head of Sales, Dedicated
Redwood Inference
From: Alicia Gomez <agomez@clarionbio.com>
To: Priyom Das <priyom@redwood.ai>
Cc: Clarion Procurement <procure@clarionbio.com>
Date: Mon, 15 Mar 2027 10:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Anchoring SKUs and phased onramp - request

Priyom — this looks promising. A few clarifications from procurement:

- Clarion is internally leaning to 24 months but wants the option to accelerate to a 36-month effective discount if we commit to a faster ramp (we can agree to certain KPI gates).
- The soft-start at 40% is acceptable; however, Procurement needs stronger language on delayed start: if we can't accept capacity for >45 days due to customer-side delays, we need a material credit (minimum 50% of the soft-start month fee) or the ability to push the start without penalty.
- For SLA credits we need clear formulas (example: if p95 > target for 3 consecutive days then X% credit) and maximum cap on credits.

I'll share internal cost thresholds on Wednesday. If you can give a numeric example for anchor sizing + discounts (worst-case billing in month 1-3, steady-state month 12), that will move this to procurement review.

Thanks,
Alicia
From: Monica Patel <monica@redwood.ai>
To: Priyom Das <priyom@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 15 Mar 2027 11:20:00 -0700
Subject: Internal: Clarion counterpoints / recommended language

Internal notes for counter (keeping concise for call):
- Anchor sizing: based on the XLSX, suggest anchor = 40 vGPU-equivalents (gives headroom for 6-month growth).
- Billing carveouts:
  * Soft-start billing = 35% of anchor fee months 1-3 (we can concede from 40% to 35% to be more competitive).
  * Delayed-acceptance credit: allow a single 60-day deferred start or up to 45 days with a 50% credit for those months. After 45 days, convert remaining soft-start months to consumption at the discounted overage rate.
- SLA formula proposal:
  * p95 latency target = 1.4x baseline test latency for your median sequence (from onboarding tests).
  * If p95 breaches target for 3 consecutive days: 5% credit of anchor monthly fee for each day, capped at 25% per month.
- KPI-triggered accelerated discount: if Clarion demonstrates 80% utilization of anchor for a rolling 30-day window within the first 9 months, we provide an addendum to move from 18% discount to 22% for remainder of term (24-mo baseline). For 36-mo, move from 25% to 28%.

Recommend we present two negotiated bullets to Clarion: (A) 24-mo anchor with improved soft-start (35%) + explicit 45/60-day delayed start language; (B) 36-mo anchor with faster ramp and stronger discount tied to utilization gates.

I'll build these into the PDF and include a simple cost table.

- Monica
Customer Success, Redwood Inference

Alicia — attaching the options PDF (Redwood_Onramp_Options_20270314.pdf) with concrete numbers so you can circulate to procurement. Summary of our counterproposal:

- Anchor proposal (example numbers):
  * Anchor pool: 40 vGPU-equivalents
  * 24-month term: 18% discount off list, soft-start months 1-3 billed at 35% anchor fee, linear ramp to 100% by month 8.
  * 36-month term: 25% discount off list, soft-start months 1-2 at 30%, linear ramp to 100% by month 6.
- Delayed-start protection: single 60-day defer option or 45 days with 50% soft-start credit; beyond that convert to consumption-months at negotiated overage rate.
- SLA & credits: p95 formula as suggested by Monica; credits pro-rated and capped at 25%/month.
- Acceleration clause: if Clarion hits 80% anchor utilization for a rolling 30-day window within first 9 months, we will amend to the next discount tier for remainder of the term.

We can tighten language on the credit math in the contract addendum. If this looks ok to you, can we lock a call Thursday 10am PT to review with Procurement + Legal? I can have our Sales Ops produce an updated quote for DocuSign after the call.

Thanks — look forward to moving this forward.

— Priyom
